title: The first MCP operation exports through its own environment bindings
summary: The generated MCP route supplies OTLP_SINKS and ARCHITECT_ENVIRONMENT directly to Telemetry.serve. It no longer requires an earlier ordinary API call to configure the isolate. Both committed example servers were regenerated with Nx sync.
proves: A fresh actual workerd, with only real Better Auth signup and OAuth before its first system.health tool call, sends the operation to a real OpenTelemetry Collector configured as an extra sink, with no local OTLP_URL. The trace contains system.health and both deployment environment attributes. The original MCP typed read, role refusal and secret-field checks still pass. Generator, MCP/auth and static checks are captured separately.

captions.01-fails-first: The first tool succeeds, but no system.health span reaches the real Collector before the fix.
captions.02-mcp-tests: The new first-operation telemetry regression and existing real MCP read/role/privacy flow pass.
captions.03-related-tests: All generator tests plus the runtime MCP and workerd Better Auth guards.
captions.04-static: All-project lint/typecheck, generated drift check and whitespace validation.
captions.04-integrated-mcp: The conductor verifies first-MCP actual Collector export and existing OAuth/get/role flows after regeneration.
